input.command:
APK="/Users/stark/Desktop/work/RN/heals-app-rn/android/app/build/outputs/apk/dev/release/app-dev-release.apk"
AAPT="$ANDROID_HOME/build-tools/36.0.0/aapt"
APKSIGNER="$ANDROID_HOME/build-tools/36.0.0/apksigner"
ls -l "$APK"
echo "---BADGING---"
"$AAPT" dump badging "$APK" | grep -E "package:|application-label:|native-code|sdkVersion|targetSdkVersion"
echo "---SIGN---"
"$APKSIGNER" verify --verbose --print-certs "$APK" 2>&1 | grep -E "Verified using|v1 scheme|v2 scheme|v3 scheme|v4 scheme|Signer #1 certificate DN|ERROR|WARNING|DOES NOT"
echo "---SHA---"
shasum -a 256 "$APK"
stat -f "bytes=%z mtime=%Sm" "$APK"
echo "---COPY---"
COPY="/tmp/heals-dev-1.2.5-1795674519.apk"
cp "$APK" "$COPY"
"$AAPT" dump badging "$COPY" | grep -E "package:"
shasum -a 256 "$COPY"
ls -l "$COPY"
input.description: Verify APK package, version, signature, hash
